reforms.description: The latest Budget provides funding for initiatives aimed at boosting universities' research capacity and improving infrastructure, which are essential for enhancing the economy's productive capacity. This includes funding for the Canada Foundation for Innovation and the creation of research centres for genomic science, alongside a framework to evaluate discretionary public spending to determine effective initiatives.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The funding and evaluation framework are designed to enhance the productive capacity of the economy, which supports growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The reforms have been explicitly stated as implemented in the latest Budget.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms involve significant funding initiatives but do not represent a structural overhaul.
reforms.source_quote: Set up a comprehensive framework to evaluate discretionary spending measures to determine whether they are achieving their objectives and to develop a list of 'what works' to target future expenditures effectively.

reforms.description: The February 1999 Budget included targeted spending initiatives in priority areas such as health care and innovation, aimed at fostering economic growth.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The targeted spending initiatives are designed to foster economic growth in priority areas.
reforms.status_evidence: The initiatives have been explicitly stated as implemented in the February 1999 Budget.
reforms.importance_rationale: The initiatives are significant but do not represent a major reform.
reforms.source_quote: The February 1999 Budget, like its predecessor, included targeted tax relief as well as spending initiatives in priority areas (such as health care and innovation).

reforms.description: The government will give Statistics Canada the mandate to collect and publish data on the supply of debt and equity financing to SMEs, building upon existing banking data to provide comprehensive information on financing needs.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Providing comprehensive information on financing needs supports SMEs in accessing necessary funding, which can enhance their growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The initiative has been explicitly stated as implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: This initiative is important for improving data availability but does not represent a major reform.
reforms.source_quote: The government will give Statistics Canada the mandate to collect and publish data on the supply of debt and equity financing to SMEs.

reforms.description: Legislation was passed allowing foreign banks to offer a full range of services via branches rather than as separate subsidiaries, promoting competition and increasing the variety of financial services available.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Promoting competition in financial services can lead to better access and options for businesses, supporting economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The legislation has been explicitly stated as implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reform is significant in enhancing competition but does not represent a major overhaul.
reforms.source_quote: Legislation was passed in June 1999 allowing foreign banks to offer a full range of services via branches rather than as separate, fully regulated banking subsidiaries.
